paper_metadata.title: A dual-phase deep learning framework for advanced phishing detection using the novel OptSHQCNN approach

summary: OptSHQCNN: a dual-phase deep learning framework for phishing URL detection combining Red Kite Optimization feature selection, a Shallow Hybrid Quantum-Classical CNN (quantum component simulated classically), SSOA hyperparameter optimization, and an OptBERT post-deployment module. Evaluated on four phishing URL datasets (ISCX-URL-2016, URL-Based Phishing, Mendeley_2020, Phishstorm) against DNN, LSTM, CNN, Bayes Net, Faster R-CNN, RNN+CNN, and CNN-with-Attention baselines. Per-dataset accuracy ~99.1-99.4%, overall accuracy 99.72% (Table 10). Authors explicitly state no real quantum simulation was run; the quantum layer is simulated on classical frameworks.

experiments.description: OptSHQCNN phishing URL classification on Mendeley_2020. Mendeley phishing URL dataset (2020); small split 58,645 and large split 88,647 records. Quantum component is simulated on classical hardware per authors' explicit statement.
